entries.52b78775e1cb9444: The Business Description section states that the company has brought in-house an integrated manufacturing process from wooden patterns, casting, heat treatment, machining and inspection; carries out the special processing of three-dimensional CAD data and equipment maintenance in-house; has raised the precision of sand casting to a level equivalent to die casting; has been selected as a Tier1 company by some vehicle manufacturers; and shares three-dimensional CAD data know-how across its three businesses, enabling staff rotation and joint use of equipment.
entries.53b00b147fa4b908: Its strengths are its in-house system for the integrated process from wooden patterns, casting, heat treatment, machining and inspection, and the know-how it has gained by carrying out even the special processing of three-dimensional CAD data and equipment maintenance in-house. Using fine-grained foundry sand and wooden patterns made with cutting machines, it has raised the precision of sand casting to a level equivalent to die casting, and it has been selected as a primary supplier by vehicle manufacturers. Another strength is that the three businesses share know-how on three-dimensional CAD data, enabling staff rotation and joint use of equipment.
entries.5e7543c42cf8e047: Under its corporate philosophy, “MADE BY JMC,” and its vision, “Bringing intelligence to manufacturing,” the company states that it aims to become the “strongest supplier” through business development not bound by existing manufacturing frameworks. In the 3D printer business, the company states that it will establish an order-receiving system for mass-produced items by providing AM services and will expand the lineup and raise awareness of “HEARTROID”; in the casting business, it will focus on prototypes and small-lot production, with short lead times and high quality as its strengths, while advancing its response to cast components for mass production and large castings; and in the CT business, it will advance market development for inspection and measurement services and the spread of the technology.
entries.72921dd78e165006: In the prototyping and development market, where accelerating EV development competition demands complex, large castings and high quality from the early prototype stage, it is positioned as a manufacturing service provider that supports everything from prototypes to final products, with a system to supply large castings through mass production and proprietary technology that combines 3D printers, casting and industrial CT.
entries.744dd469369ab929: Revenue for the fiscal year ended December 2025 was ¥3,223 million, comprising ¥2,083 million from the Casting Business, ¥764 million from the 3D Printer Business and ¥374 million from the CT Business. It was up 4.9% from the previous fiscal year.
